state.background: Review the Plan42 decision for P42-320..322. It retains the existing Playwright dark palette case as browser-owned, with no unit destination: P42-320 confirms the actual route's html[data-theme=dark] after setting localStorage before navigation; P42-321 checks all 12 CPI legend buttons are visible; P42-322 compares each rendered legend swatch's computed RGB with its matching --series-N value parsed from the :root[data-theme=dark] block in globals.css. The test iterates CPI_CATEGORIES and stackedColors from application chartConstants. Existing tests/unit/globals-css-palette.test.ts validates that source CSS scopes contain the validated light/dark palette values and mapping; it cannot prove real-route theme application, loaded stylesheet/cascade, or rendered computed swatches. Keep explicit residual uncertainty: these legend swatches do not directly prove StackedAreaChart SVG area fills follow the dark theme. No source or test changes are proposed; this is an ownership decision only.
acceptanceCriteria: The retained browser assertions cover actual theme application and rendered legend state/color in the real route.
Existing palette unit tests are treated as complementary source palette validation, not equivalent browser evidence.
The residual uncertainty about SVG area fill theme tracking remains explicit rather than overstating coverage.
The plan, callsite ledger, and responsibility matrix align on P42-320..322 browser ownership and no unit destination.
verification: Plan shared_plan/42-happy-dom-e2e-migration-plan.md identifies the dark case as browser-owned at file inventory, checkpoint, appendix row, and residual-risk statement.
Ledger shared_plan/42-assertion-callsite-ledger.md rows P42-320, P42-321, and P42-322 enumerate actual theme attribute, 12 legend visibility checks, and computed RGB checks against dark CSS values.

Responsibility matrix shared_plan/42-assertion-case-responsibility-matrix.md says dark test applies theme on real route and compares all 12 swatches; it explicitly preserves residual SVG-fill uncertainty.

The exact E2E sets localStorage theme=dark before page.goto('/'), asserts html[data-theme=dark], parses the dark CSS block, iterates CPI_CATEGORIES, requires each legend visible, and compares getComputedStyle(span).backgroundColor against parsed dark RGB.
OpenSpec Scenario R14b requires --series-1..12 variables from globals.css and StackedAreaChart colors to adapt via var(--series-N), plus palette scope consistency.
tests/unit/globals-css-palette.test.ts validates source CSS light/media-dark/dataThemeDark values against validated palettes; it does not render the app or inspect computed swatches or SVG fills.
knownConstraints: Do not claim that the swatch test proves StackedAreaChart SVG fill theme behavior; that remains an explicit residual uncertainty.
P42-320..322 are limited to dark-theme application, legend visibility, and legend swatch computed colors.
No new unit test or source/test edits are proposed. Do not invent test-run results.
